config:
zone "inside"
exit
zone "outside"
exit
interface ethernet0/0
 zone "inside"
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
exit
address "client"
 description "sanitized"
 ip 192.0.2.10/32
exit
address "server"
 ip 198.51.100.20/32
exit
service "test-https"
 tcp dst-port 443 443
exit
rule id 10
 action permit
 src-zone "inside"
 dst-zone "outside"
 src-addr "client"
 dst-addr "server"
 service "test-https"
exit
rule id 20
 action deny
 src-zone "inside"
 dst-zone "outside"
 src-addr "client"
 dst-addr "server"
 service "test-https"
 disable
exit

ip vrouter "trust-vr"
 bnatrule id 1 virtual ip 203.0.113.0/24 real ip 192.0.2.0/24
exit
address "cost-source-a"
 ip 192.0.2.30/32
exit
address "cost-source-b"
 ip 192.0.2.31/32
exit
address "cost-server"
 ip 198.51.100.99/32
exit
service "test-http"
 tcp dst-port 80 80
exit
service "test-ssh"
 tcp dst-port 22 22
exit
rule id 40
 action permit
 src-zone "inside"
 dst-zone "outside"
 src-addr "cost-source-a"
 dst-addr "cost-server"
 service "test-https"
 service "test-http"
exit
rule id 50
 action permit
 src-zone "inside"
 dst-zone "outside"
 src-addr "cost-source-b"
 dst-addr "cost-server"
 service "test-ssh"
exit
